## Summary

Describe the change and the evidence layer it affects.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] `ruff check repo_alfa tests` passes.
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] New artifacts are documented.
- [ ] Failure handling preserves the rest of the pipeline.
- [ ] No credentials, cookie values or private data are committed.
- [ ] The change stays within authorized client-visible analysis.

## Validation

Include the commands used to validate the change and any relevant sanitized output.
